join: pal_Patient + exact GEO title suffix, primary Total tumor only; unique GSM required
conflicts: retain unresolved, exclude from subtype tests
patient_unit: GEO patient characteristic; explicit shared patient regions pooled before >=20 cell filter
expression: raw counts/library size*1e4; log1p; patient mean log expression and detection
tests: 3 pairwise two-sided asymptotic Mann Whitney per unit, BH3 separate; cells and GEO patient labels
limitations: No donor-adjusted cell test, batch/depth/sex adjustment, or causal interpretation; PR-only n=1 descriptive; sources not new independent cohort
